ocarinaSongs.name: Zelda's Lullaby
ocarinaSongs.effect: Activates Royal Family Triforce symbols, summons Great Fairies, opens Darunia's door & Zora's Domain waterfall, repairs broken signs.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Sneak past the Hyrule Castle courtyard guards during the day as Child Link and speak to Princess Zelda and Impa.

ocarinaSongs.name: Epona's Song
ocarinaSongs.effect: Summons Epona anywhere in overworld fields as Adult Link; makes any Cow fill an Empty Bottle with free Lon Lon Milk.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: After waking Talon at Hyrule Castle, pull out your Ocarina directly in front of Malon in the center of Lon Lon Ranch corral during the day.

ocarinaSongs.name: Saria's Song
ocarinaSongs.effect: Lets you speak telepathically with Saria or Navi anytime; cheers up Darunia (Goron's Bracelet) and Lost Woods Skull Kid (Heart Piece + Skull Mask sale).
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Navigate Lost Woods (Right, Left, Right, Left, Straight, Left, Right) through Sacred Forest Meadow to Saria after meeting Zelda.

ocarinaSongs.name: Sun's Song
ocarinaSongs.effect: Instantly toggles Day <-> Night; freezes ReDeads and Gibdos in place; spawns big fairies from certain Gossip Stones.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol at the far back of Kakariko Graveyard, drop into the Royal Family's Tomb, pass the Keese and ReDeads, and inspect the carved stone tablet.

ocarinaSongs.name: Song of Time
ocarinaSongs.effect: Opens the Door of Time in the Temple of Time; toggles blue Song of Time stone blocks across dungeons and grottos.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Return to the Hyrule Castle Town drawbridge moat with all 3 Spiritual Stones and dive for the Ocarina of Time thrown by Princess Zelda.

ocarinaSongs.name: Song of Storms
ocarinaSongs.effect: Summons rainstorms, drains the Kakariko Well (when played inside the Windmill as Child), opens hidden storm grottos, grows Magic Bean sprouts for fairies, and refills the Desert Colossus oasis.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Enter the Kakariko Village Windmill as Adult Link and pull out the Ocarina in front of Guru-Guru.

ocarinaSongs.name: Minuet of Forest
ocarinaSongs.effect: Warps Child or Adult Link directly to the Sacred Forest Meadow pad outside the Forest Temple.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Reach the Forest Temple courtyard in Sacred Forest Meadow as Adult Link.

ocarinaSongs.name: Bolero of Fire
ocarinaSongs.effect: Warps Child or Adult Link directly to the central Death Mountain Crater pad (required for Child Link to plant the Crater Magic Bean & drop Bug!).
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Enter Death Mountain Crater through Darunia's secret statue passage in Goron City as Adult Link and Hookshot across the broken bridge.

ocarinaSongs.name: Serenade of Water
ocarinaSongs.effect: Warps Child or Adult Link directly to the island pad above the Water Temple in Lake Hylia.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Open the Iron Boots chest at the end of the Ice Cavern.

ocarinaSongs.name: Requiem of Spirit
ocarinaSongs.effect: Warps Child or Adult Link to Desert Colossus (the ONLY way Child Link can reach Desert Colossus & Spirit Temple!).
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Cross the Haunted Wasteland as Adult Link, enter the Spirit Temple, and walk back outside.

ocarinaSongs.name: Nocturne of Shadow
ocarinaSongs.effect: Warps Child or Adult Link onto the high upper cliff of Kakariko Graveyard leading to the Shadow Temple.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Enter Kakariko Village as Adult Link after clearing the Forest, Fire, and Water Temples.

ocarinaSongs.name: Prelude of Light
ocarinaSongs.effect: Warps Child or Adult Link directly into the Temple of Time; unlocks Pedestal of Time era-swapping.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Enter the Temple of Time after defeating Phantom Ganon in the Forest Temple.

ocarinaSongs.name: Scarecrow's Song
switch2Buttons: Any 8 notes using >= 2 buttons (e.g. Y, X, Y, X, Y, X, Y, X)
ocarinaSongs.effect: Summons Pierre the wandering scarecrow as a Hookshot/Longshot grapple target on hidden high ledges across Hyrule and dungeons.
ocarinaSongs.howToGet: Step 1 (Child Link): Pull out your Ocarina before Bonooru (the lower scarecrow by the Fishing Pond path at Lake Hylia) and play an easy-to-remember 8-note tune. Step 2 (Adult Link): Play that exact same 8-note tune back to Bonooru at Lake Hylia to activate Pierre permanently.

magicBeans.location: Directly beside the Magic Bean Seller at Zora's River entrance
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Shortcut up Zora's River & alternate jump to Lower River Pillar Heart Piece.
Rides along upper Kokiri canopy for continuous Blue Rupees.

magicBeans.location: Bridge area (Left, Left from Kokiri Forest entrance)
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Direct shortcut up onto the Kokiri <-> Hyrule Field bridge + Blue Rupees.

magicBeans.location: Forest Stage butterfly clearing (Right, Left, Right, Left, Straight, Left)
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Required for Gold Skulltula #6 on the upper ledge.

magicBeans.location: Left side of Kakariko Graveyard against cliff wall
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Primary path to the Graveyard High Cliff Crate Heart Piece.

magicBeans.location: Right outside the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Primary path to Dodongo's Cavern Entrance Cliff Heart Piece & shortcut up trail.
Primary path to Lakeside Laboratory Rooftop Heart Piece.

magicBeans.location: Bottom canyon ledge beside the Cow (Cucco-glide down)
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Scenic ride up canyon waterfalls for Red/Blue Rupees.

magicBeans.location: Beside the Bolero of Fire warp pad (requires learning Bolero as Adult first!)
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Required for Volcano Bean Spire Heart Piece.

magicBeans.location: Right of the Spirit Temple stairs (requires learning Requiem of Spirit as Adult first!)
magicBeans.adultPayoff: Required for Desert Colossus Stone Archway Heart Piece and Mesa Skulltula.

happyMaskQuest.buyer: Death Mountain Trail Gate Guard in Kakariko Village (daytime)
happyMaskQuest.proTip: Opens right after you show Zelda's Letter to this exact guard!

happyMaskQuest.buyer: Lone Skull Kid (Left from Lost Woods entrance)
happyMaskQuest.proTip: BEFORE or AFTER selling, wear the Skull Mask inside the Lost Woods Forest Stage grotto to unlock Deku Stick Upgrade #2 (30 Sticks)! Note: he pays 10 Rupees so bring 10 extra Rupees to repay the 20-Rupee shop fee.

happyMaskQuest.buyer: Graveyard Boy patrolling Kakariko Graveyard during the DAY
happyMaskQuest.proTip: Only appears during daytime (06:00–18:00), while Dampé patrols at night.

happyMaskQuest.buyer: Running Man jogging around Hyrule Field (unlocks in shop ONLY after collecting all 3 Spiritual Stones!)
happyMaskQuest.proTip: Wait along the Lon Lon Ranch perimeter path until he sits down to rest at night, speak to him wearing the Bunny Hood, and he completely fills your Wallet! Unlocks the Mask of Truth (+ Zora, Goron, and Gerudo Masks) at the Happy Mask Shop.

biggoronSwordQuest.instructions: Speak to the Cucco Lady (Anju) near the Graveyard entrance as Adult Link.
Play Sun's Song (or sleep until morning) to hatch the Pocket Egg, then enter the lower Kakariko house and use the Pocket Cucco to wake sleeping Talon.
Show the woken-Talon result back to Anju outside; she trades you her blue Cucco, Cojiro.
Go Left from the Lost Woods entrance as Adult Link and use Cojiro to wake Grog sitting by the stump. He hands you the Odd Mushroom (starts a 4:00 timer—DO NOT play warp songs!).

Dash through Lost Woods -> Goron City shortcut (or Epona across Hyrule Field) to Kakariko Village, walk through the main Potion Shop's back door (or Hookshot the roof), and give the Odd Mushroom to Granny.
Return to Grog's stump (Left from Lost Woods entrance) and give the Odd Poultice to the Kokiri girl Fado standing there. (Note: Switch 2 fixed the old N64 Forest Stage Deku Nut glitch here!)
Cross the Gerudo Valley bridge (via Epona or Longshot) and hand the Poacher's Saw to Mutoh, the boss carpenter outside the tent.
Climb to the summit of Death Mountain Trail (outside the Great Fairy Fountain) and show the Broken Goron's Sword to giant Biggoron.
Ensure King Zora is thawed (via Blue Fire or beating the Water Temple so all of Zora's Domain thaws in Switch 2!) and show him the Prescription. Starts a strict 2:30 timer—NO warp songs!

SWITCH 2 PRO SHORTCUT: If you already beat the Water Temple, Zora's Domain is thawed—simply dive straight through the Zora's Domain -> Lake Hylia underwater warp tunnel to reach the Lakeside Lab in 25 seconds! (Otherwise gallop down Zora's River -> Hyrule Field on Epona.) Hand the Eyeball Frog to the Professor to start a 3:30 timer.

Race from Lake Hylia to Kakariko Village on Epona (or swim Lake Hylia -> thawed Zora's Domain -> Lost Woods -> Goron City -> Death Mountain Trail!) without playing warp songs and deliver the Eye Drops to Biggoron before 3:30 expires.
Play the Sun's Song 6 times (3 full days) right in front of Biggoron and present the Claim Check to claim the unbreakable, double-damage Biggoron's Sword!

cowsAndKeyGrottos.title: Link's House Personal Cow
cowsAndKeyGrottos.howToGet: After freeing Epona, talk to Malon at Lon Lon Ranch as Adult Link and beat her obstacle-course record (< 0:50). She ships a Cow directly into Link's House in Kokiri Forest—play Epona's Song anytime for free Lon Lon Milk!

cowsAndKeyGrottos.title: Gerudo Valley Approach Cow Grotto
cowsAndKeyGrottos.howToGet: Bomb the ring of stones (Child) or smash the boulder (Adult w/ Hammer) before Gerudo Valley to access a Cow + Gold Skulltula #9.

cowsAndKeyGrottos.title: Death Mountain Trail Song of Storms Cow Grotto
cowsAndKeyGrottos.howToGet: Play Song of Storms beside the circle of rocks near the Goron City / Summit climb to open a hidden Cow grotto for free milk before tackling Death Mountain Crater.

cowsAndKeyGrottos.title: Lon Lon Ranch Stables & Shed Cows (4 Total)
cowsAndKeyGrottos.howToGet: 2 Cows stand inside the Lon Lon Ranch Stables and 2 stand inside the SW Storage Shed crawlspace—play Epona's Song to fill all 5 Bottles for free.

cowsAndKeyGrottos.title: Desert Colossus Oasis Fairy Pond
cowsAndKeyGrottos.howToGet: Stand on the small stone block beside the dry oasis basin in Desert Colossus and play the Song of Storms to permanently fill the pond and spawn Bottled Fairies.

switch2Exclusives.title: Hall of Fallen Foes (84 Statues & Boss Rush)
switch2Exclusives.description: Unlocked after beating the Forest Temple, returning to Child Link, viewing Kaepora Gaebora's scene in Kakariko Village, and sleeping in any green-glowing bed (Link's House, Kakariko, or Lake Hylia). Automatically populates 84 enemy & boss statues as you defeat foes (no camera required!), lets you rematch any boss or mini-boss (including Dark Link and Iron Knuckles), and features timed Boss Rush Gauntlets graded Bronze / Silver / Gold / Master.

switch2Exclusives.title: Threads of Time: Malon's Ranch Song
switch2Exclusives.description: Open the Threads of Time journal (press Minus, then Y for the dual-era Tapestry) to complete Malon's cross-era character epilogue at Lon Lon Ranch. Step 1 (Child Link): Wake Talon at Hyrule Castle and learn Epona's Song from Malon inside the ranch corral. Step 2 (Adult Link): Win Epona from Ingo, clear Malon's obstacle course after unlocking Time Travel, and speak with Malon beside the corral fence to perform a duet of Epona's Song and stamp her Thread COMPLETE.

switch2Exclusives.title: Threads of Time: Darunia's Goron Heirloom
switch2Exclusives.description: Complete Darunia and young Link the Goron's multi-era Thread of Time inside Goron City. Step 1 (Child Link): Cheer up Patriarch Darunia with Saria's Song and seal your vow of Sworn Brotherhood after Dodongo's Cavern. Step 2 (Adult Link): Wield the Megaton Hammer to awaken Darunia as the Fire Sage in the Fire Temple, then return to Goron City's bottom patriarch chamber and speak with young Link the Goron to inspect Darunia's Sworn-Brother Heirloom and stamp his Thread COMPLETE.

switch2Exclusives.title: Threads of Time: Ruto & the Unfrozen Domain
switch2Exclusives.description: Experience Switch 2's landmark post-Water Temple restoration of Zora's Domain. Defeat Morpha in the Water Temple to awaken Princess Ruto as the Water Sage and permanently thaw the ice sealing Zora's Domain, then return to King Zora's throne room and the restored waterfall basin to celebrate with the Zora court and stamp Ruto's Thread of Time COMPLETE.

switch2Exclusives.title: Threads of Time: Nabooru's Desert Accord
switch2Exclusives.description: Forge the desert alliance between the Gerudo thieves and Hyrule in Nabooru's Switch 2 Thread of Time. Earn the Gerudo Membership Card by freeing all four Carpenters, claim the Mirror Shield and awaken Nabooru as the Spirit Sage in the Spirit Temple, then speak with Nabooru's second-in-command atop Gerudo's Fortress overlooking the repaired canyon bridge to stamp her Thread COMPLETE.

switch2Exclusives.title: Threads of Time: Impa's Sheikah Legacy
switch2Exclusives.description: Uncover the hidden history of Kakariko's protector in Impa's Switch 2 Thread of Time. Step 1 (Child Link): Drain Kakariko's well with the Song of Storms and claim the Sheikah heirloom Lens of Truth from the Bottom of the Well. Step 2 (Adult Link): Earn the Hover Boots and awaken Impa as the Shadow Sage in the Shadow Temple, then step inside Impa's House in Kakariko Village and inspect her hidden Sheikah chronicle with the Lens of Truth to stamp her Thread COMPLETE.

switch2Exclusives.title: Threads of Time: Saria's Eternal Forest
switch2Exclusives.description: Revisit Link and Saria's bond across eras at the Sacred Forest Meadow sanctum. Step 1 (Child Link): Learn Saria's Song on the tree stump inside the Sacred Forest Meadow terrace. Step 2 (Adult Link): Defeat Phantom Ganon with the Fairy Bow to awaken Saria as the Forest Sage and unlock Time Travel, then return to the quiet tree stump outside the Forest Temple and play Saria's Song to hear her forest echo across time and stamp her Thread COMPLETE.

switch2Exclusives.title: Zelda Notes Companion & Gossip Quests (Patch 1.1.1)
switch2Exclusives.description: Free companion module inside the Nintendo Switch Mobile App (no NSO subscription required). Offers live GPS-style map sync, Gossip Quests (photo-clue scavenger hunts across Hyrule), shareable custom Ocarina sheet music, daily quizzes, and global Hall of Fallen Foes leaderboards.
